Stable quiet holding stance with both feet planted on the same ground plane, clamp arms balanced low, full operator and frame visible. No Blender/3D-render appearance, glossy plastic, anime, mobile-game proportions, photorealistic concept art, excessive blue glow, Zaun acid-green chemicals, magic gun, flight, white Demacian petricite or copied original HoMM3 monster.
